gaps.sentence: The more you practise, ___ easier it becomes.
gaps.explanation: 'The more … the easier …' — both halves take 'the'.

gaps.sentence: The findings will be published in ___ course.
gaps.hint: in ___ course = at the right time
gaps.explanation: 'In due course' = eventually, when the time is right.

gaps.sentence: He'd rather cook at home tonight, ___ he?
gaps.explanation: The tag repeats the auxiliary: would → wouldn't.

gaps.sentence: She made the cake ___, without any help at all.
gaps.explanation: 'She made it herself' — the reflexive stresses she did it alone.

gaps.sentence: She got the job ___ of her lack of experience.
We'll start the meeting ___ everyone arrives.
gaps.explanation: 'when/once/until' — here 'when everyone arrives' starts the event.
'Neither of + plural noun + singular verb' (formal English).
